candidate_sources.title: citrus huanglongbing (greening) disease | CABI Compendium
candidate_sources.snippet: The CABI Compendium datasheet on citrus huanglongbing covers Identity, Overview, Distribution, Dispersal, Hosts/Species Affected, Vectors & Intermediate Hosts, Diagnosis, Biology & Ecology, Impacts, Prevention/Control, and Further Information. The disease is caused by Candidatus Liberibacter species vectored by the Asian citrus psyllid.

candidate_sources.title: Huanglongbing / Citrus / Agriculture: Pest Management Guidelines | UC Statewide IPM Program
candidate_sources.snippet: UC IPM Program provides comprehensive pest management guidelines for Huanglongbing in citrus crops, including identification of blotchy mottle symptoms on leaves and misshapen fruit, biology of the Asian citrus psyllid vector, and integrated management strategies.

candidate_sources.title: Citrus Huanglongbing: The Pathogen and Its Impact | Plant Health Progress
candidate_sources.snippet: Review article presenting main features and symptoms of huanglongbing disease, the causal organisms (Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus and related species), vectors including the Asian citrus psyllid, and documented impacts for Florida and Brazil, with coverage of disease management approaches.

candidate_sources.title: First Report of Penicillium ulaiense Causing Postharvest Whisker Mold of Oranges (Citrus sinensis) in Spain
candidate_sources.snippet: First Report of Penicillium ulaiense Causing Postharvest Whisker Mold of Oranges (Citrus sinensis) in Spain. Whisker mold caused by Penicillium ulaiense is a concern during citrus storage. The rotted portion of the fruit is covered with a white, compact fungal growth with olive green spores. Whisker-like coremia (1–8 mm) distinguish it from other citrus molds.

candidate_sources.title: First Report of Whisker Mold as a Postharvest Disease Caused by Penicillium ulaiense on Citrus (Citrus unshiu) in Korea
candidate_sources.snippet: First Report of Whisker Mold as a Postharvest Disease Caused by Penicillium ulaiense on Citrus (Citrus unshiu) in Korea. Whisker mold displays a water-soaked, circular lesion with a blue-gray spore mass covered by coremia (whisker-like structures) with white stalks and mycelia. Disease incidence was 5 to 10% across markets surveyed.

candidate_sources.title: First Report of Whisker Mold of Citrus (Citrus sinensis) Caused by Penicillium ulaiense in Pakistan
candidate_sources.snippet: First Report of Whisker Mold of Citrus (Citrus sinensis) Caused by Penicillium ulaiense in Pakistan. Penicillium ulaiense causes whisker mold on stored citrus fruit, a postharvest disease that affects citrus fruits during storage with characteristic whisker-like fungal structures.
